label: GO step late in the episode (trial >= ~85) after an unrewarded visit to S1
explanation: Fires only at the GO step (never at D1 or D2) and only in the last part of the episode: nothing before trial ~80, 86% of activation mass in trials 90-99, and the value-head output is low (89% of mass where value < 5.22). It needs the previous trial to be unrewarded (prev_reward=1 carries under 1% of mass) and is strongly tied to that unrewarded trial having reached S1. The previous trial being a1 -> S1 common and unrewarded is the cleanest case: GO & late & prev unrewarded & prev a1 common gives precision 0.93 but recall 0.57. Unrewarded rare visits to S1 (a2 -> S1) also count but fire less reliably, and those are most of the false positives. The recorded predicate uses only observed variables (episode time, the previous reward and the previous state). Dev scores: P 0.54, R 0.77, F1 0.64, mass recall 0.87. Episode position alone with prev_reward=0 reaches mass recall 0.98 but precision only 0.24. Adding the upcoming policy sign (choice > 0) raises precision to 0.96 but halves recall. The 13% of mass the predicate misses is mostly late GO steps after unrewarded a2 -> S2 trials. Activations are larger later in the episode and largest after common-unrewarded a1 trials. It does not fire after rewarded trials, at delay steps, or early in the episode.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over last trial (GO: a1 S1 u, a2 S1 u, ?) and value (model) (GO: decile 0 (9 , decile 1 (9 ); timing cues that raise it most: phase=GO & ep_dec=9, phase=GO & ep_dec=8, phase=D2 & ep_dec=0.
